memory_update.text: Core US-listed direct-exposure universe for AI cluster networking and optics should include AVGO, NVDA, ANET, MRVL, and COHR as first-pass leaders across switch silicon, networking systems, Ethernet platforms, DSP/interconnect silicon, and optical modules/components.

Potential next-pass additions not included due to the five-candidate limit: LITE for lasers/modules and NVIDIA optics partnership, CIEN for coherent optical/DCI, GLW for fiber/cable and optical connectivity, AMPH for high-speed interconnect/cables, CLS/JBL for switch/system manufacturing, and QCOM/INTC only if credible AI networking silicon evidence appears.

The most direct chokepoint mapping is not generic AI compute but data movement: Ethernet/InfiniBand switch ASICs, NICs, optical DSPs, 800G/1.6T pluggable modules, silicon photonics, lasers, and eventual CPO.

Need follow-up evidence on revenue materiality and customer concentration: product announcements confirm technical exposure, but not all companies disclose how much revenue or margin comes from AI networking and optics.
